interactive_elements.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST have distinct hover states (darker backgrounds or elevated shadows).
interactive_elements.focus_states: Visible focus rings (using primary color) MUST be present on all focusable elements.

icons.usage: Use crisp, clean line icons. Size typically 16px to 20px (w-4 h-4 to w-5 h-5).

image_urls.description: Abstract minimalist grid texture for the login screen background to convey data and mapping.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for standard text. Uses pure black and dark slates for readability.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sheet-selector-dropdown', data-testid='map-marker-edit-btn').

specific_instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI for standard components (Dropdown, Select, Dialog, Sheet for the right edit panel).
The application should launch into a clean Login screen featuring Microsoft OAuth prominently.
Once authenticated, the main view is a full-screen Google Map. Overlaid on the map is a left-aligned floating control panel (for selecting the Excel file, sheet, and toggling column visibility).
Clicking a map marker opens a slide-out panel on the right (or a Shadcn Sheet) to edit the row's data. It uses progressive disclosure.
Maintain the F-Pattern: Brand/File selection top left, map content center, editing right.
Ensure the edit form binds dynamically to the columns (excluding the fixed lat/lng columns).
Use pure CSS/Tailwind for the map overlay layouts rather than standard generic grids, to achieve the 'Godly' dashboard aesthetic (crisp borders, subtle shadows, high utility).
